# camunda_cluster_monitoring_client (Resource)

Manage a client that may scrape the metrics of a cluster with external monitoring, see `camunda_cluster_monitoring`. The password is only returned when the client is created or its password is rotated, so it can't be imported. To rotate it, change `rotation_trigger`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "camunda_cluster_monitoring" "test" {
  cluster_id = camunda_cluster.test.id
}

resource "camunda_cluster_monitoring_client" "test" {
  cluster_id = camunda_cluster.test.id
  username   = "prometheus"

  # Change this value to rotate the password.
  rotation_trigger = "2026-01"

  depends_on = [camunda_cluster_monitoring.test]
}

output "prometheus_password" {
  value     = camunda_cluster_monitoring_client.test.password
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID
- `username` (String) The username to scrape with. Changing it replaces the client.

### Optional

- `rotation_trigger` (String) Any value; changing it rotates the client's password and stores the new one in `password`. For example, set it to a `time_rotating` resource's `rotation_rfc3339`.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) The ID of the client.
- `created` (String) When the client was created, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) ID of the user that created the client.
- `created_by_name` (String) Name of the user that created the client.
- `id` (String) Monitoring client ID, in the form `<cluster_id>/<client_id>`
- `name` (String) The name of the client.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The client's password. Only known after creating the client or rotating its password.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Monitoring clients are imported by "<cluster_id>/<client_id>". The password can't be imported.
terraform import camunda_cluster_monitoring_client.test '<cluster_id>/<client_id>'
```
